## Pooled House and Senate

 m_district_full_far_right_cross

```{r  m_district_full_far_right_cross}
# controlling for member - level 
 m_district_full_far_right_cross <-fenegbin (
  perYear ~ 
    population_m + 
    chamber + 
    #workers_self_employed + 
    # workers_private_sector + 
    # workers_nonprofit + 
     percent_workers_government + 
     percent_education_bachelor_or_higher + 
     percent_public_assistance_or_snap_households + 
    # percent_workers_self_employed + 
    # percent_workers_private_sector + 
    # percent_workers_nonprofit + 
    # electoral 
    competitive + 
    #PACamount_m + 
    # institution
    chair + 
    subchr + 
    ranking_minority + 
    #prestige + 
    oversight +  
    # member level 
    state_leg + 
    experience + 
     abs(nominate_dim1) + far_right + 
    distance*presidents_party #+ majority 
  | Year_x_Agency, 
                    cluster = "Legislator",
           data = data_district)

if(testing){modelsummary::modelsummary( m_district_full_far_right_cross, stars = T)}
```

## " models_district_full_far_right.Rdata"

```{r  models_district_full_far_right}
 models_district_full_far_right <- list(
  "(1)" =  m_district_full_far_right_cross,
  "(2)" =  m_district_full_far_right_did,
  "(3)" =   m_district_full_far_right_house_cross,
  "(4)" =  m_district_full_far_right_house_did,
  "(5)" =  m_district_full_far_right_senate_cross,
  "(6)" =  m_district_full_far_right_senate_did
)

rows <- tibble(
  term = c("Dependent variable", 
           "All legislators", 
           "Only House",
           "Only Senate"),
  `(1)` = c("Count", "X", "", ""),
  `(2)` = c("Count", "X", "", ""),
  `(3)` = c("Count", "", "X", ""),
  `(4)` = c("Count", "", "X", ""),
  `(5)` = c("Count", "", "", "X"),
  `(6)` = c("Count", "", "", "X")
  )

attr(rows, 'position') <- c(0)

# load(here::here("models", type, " models_district_full_far_right.Rdata")))
modelsummary( models_district_full_far_right) |> 
  group_tt(i = list(
    "Demand"= 2,
    "Political Environment" = 10,
    "Political Environment & Capcacy" = 26,
    "Capacity" = 28
  )) |> 
  style_tt(i = 44, line = "t", line_color = "black", line_width = 0.2) |>
  style_tt("groupi", background = "grey") |>
  style_tt("~groupi", j = 1, indent = 2)

beta_did <- betas( m_district_full_far_right_did)
se_did <- standard_errors( m_district_full_far_right_did)
beta_cross <- betas( m_district_full_far_right_cross)
se_cross <- standard_errors( m_district_full_far_right_cross)

save( models_district_full_far_right, rows, cm, gm,   beta_cross, beta_did, se_cross, se_did,
     file = here::here("models", type, " models_district_full_far_right.Rdata"))
```
